name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing host or system to initially access a network. Common weaknesses include SQL injection, cross-site scripting, deserialization flaws, and remote code execution vulnerabilities in web servers, applications, and APIs.
detection: Monitor application logs and web application firewalls for anomalous or malicious requests such as injection payloads, unusual user agents, and requests to sensitive paths. Correlate exploitation attempts with subsequent unexpected process execution on the server.
mitigations: M1051: Update Software — patch known vulnerabilities promptly
M1050: Exploit Protection — deploy a web application firewall
M1030: Network Segmentation — isolate exposed services in a DMZ
